q: 我们吃饭___要先洗手。
zh: 我们吃饭以前要先洗手。
py: wǒ men chī fàn yǐ qián yào xiān xǐ shǒu
en: We must wash our hands before we eat.
why: "Before eating" is the clause + 以前. 以后 would say wash after eating, which clashes with 先, and 后来 cannot attach to a clause at all.

q: 爸爸下班___，我们一起做饭。
zh: 爸爸下班以后，我们一起做饭。
py: bà ba xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ men yī qǐ zuò fàn
en: After Dad gets off work, we cook together.
why: "After X" is X + 以后. 后来 cannot follow a clause, 从前 never follows anything, and 以前 would put the cooking before work ends.

q: 我小___时候住在奶奶家。
zh: 我小的时候住在奶奶家。
py: wǒ xiǎo de shí hou zhù zài nǎi nai jiā
en: When I was little I lived at Grandma's house.
why: "When" is clause + 的时候, and after an adjective like 小 the 的 is required. 了, 着 and 过 do not link a clause to 时候.

q: 我们是三年___搬到这个城市的。
zh: 我们是三年以前搬到这个城市的。
py: wǒ men shì sān nián yǐ qián bān dào zhè ge chéng shì de
en: We moved to this city three years ago.
why: "Ago" is time amount + 以前. 以后 would mean three years later, 后来 cannot follow an amount, and 从前 never follows an amount.

q: 三年___，我想买一套大房子。
zh: 三年以后，我想买一套大房子。
py: sān nián yǐ hòu wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī tào dà fáng zi
en: In three years I want to buy a bigger flat.
why: "In three years" is amount + 以后. 后来 is past only and 然后 cannot follow an amount; 以前 would mean three years ago.

q: 孩子睡觉___，爸爸给他讲了一个故事。
zh: 孩子睡觉以前，爸爸给他讲了一个故事。
py: hái zi shuì jiào yǐ qián bà ba gěi tā jiǎng le yī gè gù shì
en: Before the child went to sleep, Dad told him a story.
why: "Before X" is X + 以前. 以后 would put the story after the child was asleep, and 后来 and 然后 cannot sit right after a clause.

q: 我找路___，一个陌生人问我要去哪儿。
zh: 我找路的时候，一个陌生人问我要去哪儿。
py: wǒ zhǎo lù de shí hou yī gè mò shēng rén wèn wǒ yào qù nǎ r
en: While I was looking for the way, a stranger asked me where I was going.
why: "While doing X" is X + 的时候. 以后 and 之后 mean after the search was over, and 以前 means before it, so neither fits the English "while".

q: 我们搬家___，邻居们都来帮忙，所以一天就搬完了。
zh: 我们搬家的时候，邻居们都来帮忙，所以一天就搬完了。
py: wǒ men bān jiā de shí hou lín jū men dōu lái bāng máng suǒ yǐ yī tiān jiù bān wán le
en: When we moved house, all the neighbours came to help, so it was done in one day.
why: The neighbours helped during the move, so 搬家的时候. 以后 and 以前 would place the help after or before the move, and 后来 cannot follow a clause.

q: 孩子们放学___，我要先去超市买菜，再去接他们。
zh: 孩子们放学以前，我要先去超市买菜，再去接他们。
py: hái zi men fàng xué yǐ qián wǒ yào xiān qù chāo shì mǎi cài zài qù jiē tā men
en: Before the kids finish school, I need to go to the supermarket first and then pick them up.
why: The shopping happens first, so 放学以前. 以后 would be after school ends, which clashes with going to pick them up, and 然后 cannot follow a clause.

q: 你到了公交车站___，给我打个电话，我去接你。
zh: 你到了公交车站以后，给我打个电话，我去接你。
py: nǐ dào le gōng jiāo chē zhàn yǐ hòu gěi wǒ dǎ gè diàn huà wǒ qù jiē nǐ
en: After you get to the bus stop, give me a call and I will come and pick you up.
why: Call after arriving = 到了公交车站以后. 以前 would mean before arriving, 后来 is past only, and 从前 never follows a clause.

q: 他来___时候，我正在做饭。
zh: 他来的时候，我正在做饭。
py: tā lái de shí hou wǒ zhèng zài zuò fàn
en: When he came, I was cooking.
why: A verb clause needs 的 before 时候: 他来的时候. 了, 着 and 过 cannot replace 的 here.

q: 下课___，我们回家。
zh: 下课以后，我们回家。
py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men huí jiā
en: After class we go home.
why: "After X" attaches to the clause: 下课以后. 后来 and 然后 cannot follow 下课, and 从前 never follows a clause.

q: 我们以前住在小房子里，___搬到了大房子。
zh: 我们以前住在小房子里，后来搬到了大房子。
py: wǒ men yǐ qián zhù zài xiǎo fáng zi lǐ hòu lái bān dào le dà fáng zi
en: We used to live in a small house, and later moved to a big one.
why: Standing alone in a past story, "later on" is 后来. 以后 alone points to the future, and 以前 and 之前 look backwards, not forward.

q: 小李小时候很害羞，___他变得爱说话了。
zh: 小李小时候很害羞，后来他变得爱说话了。
py: xiǎo lǐ xiǎo shí hou hěn hài xiū hòu lái tā biàn de ài shuō huà le
en: Little Li was shy as a child; later he became talkative.
why: Years pass between the two states, in a past story: 后来. 以后 alone would be future, while 从前 and 之前 look back.

q: 明天我要去超市，___回家做饭。
zh: 明天我要去超市，然后回家做饭。
py: míng tiān wǒ yào qù chāo shì rán hòu huí jiā zuò fàn
en: Tomorrow I'll go to the supermarket and then go home to cook.
why: The next step in a plan is 然后. 后来 is past only, and 以前 and 从前 point backwards.

q: 对不起，___我一定常常回家看你们。
zh: 对不起，以后我一定常常回家看你们。
py: duì bù qǐ yǐ hòu wǒ yī dìng cháng cháng huí jiā kàn nǐ men
en: Sorry, from now on I will definitely come home to see you often.
why: "From now on" is 以后 standing alone. 后来 cannot be used for the future, and 以前 would look back to the past.

q: 奶奶开始不同意，___同意了。
zh: 奶奶开始不同意，后来同意了。
py: nǎi nai kāi shǐ bù tóng yì hòu lái tóng yì le
en: At first Grandma didn't agree, but later she did.
why: "At first … later" in a past story is 开始 … 后来. 以后 alone would be future, and 之前 and 从前 look backwards.

q: 周末我们打算在公园里走一走，___去河边吃饭。
zh: 周末我们打算在公园里走一走，然后去河边吃饭。
py: zhōu mò wǒ men dǎ suàn zài gōng yuán lǐ zǒu yī zǒu rán hòu qù hé biān chī fàn
en: At the weekend we plan to walk around the park and then eat by the river.
why: A plan lists steps with 然后. 后来 is past only, and 之前 and 从前 look backwards.

q: 妹妹三岁的时候很怕狗，___她养了一只小狗，就不怕了。
zh: 妹妹三岁的时候很怕狗，后来她养了一只小狗，就不怕了。
py: mèi mei sān suì de shí hou hěn pà gǒu hòu lái tā yǎng le yī zhī xiǎo gǒu jiù bù pà le
en: My sister was afraid of dogs at three; later she got a puppy and stopped being afraid.
why: A change over time in a past story is 后来. 以后 alone would be future, and 之前 and 从前 look back instead of forward.

q: 爸爸看了看我，___什么也没说。
zh: 爸爸看了看我，然后什么也没说。
py: bà ba kàn le kàn wǒ rán hòu shén me yě méi shuō
en: Dad looked at me and then said nothing.
why: Two actions right after each other are joined by 然后. 后来 implies a gap of time, and 以后 and 以前 cannot link two clauses.

q: 他们小时候是邻居，长大以后分开了，___再也没有见过面。
zh: 他们小时候是邻居，长大以后分开了，后来再也没有见过面。
py: tā men xiǎo shí hou shì lín jū zhǎng dà yǐ hòu fēn kāi le hòu lái zài yě méi yǒu jiàn guò miàn
en: They were neighbours as children, grew up and drifted apart, and after that never met again.
why: The fixed past-story phrase is 后来再也没…. 以后 alone would point to the future and 从前 never takes this slot.

q: 我___不喝咖啡，现在每天喝一杯。
zh: 我以前不喝咖啡，现在每天喝一杯。
py: wǒ yǐ qián bù hē kā fēi xiàn zài měi tiān hē yī bēi
en: I didn't use to drink coffee; now I drink a cup every day.
why: "Formerly" standing alone is 以前, contrasting with 现在. 以后 is future, and 后来 and 然后 describe what happens next, not an earlier state.

q: ___这条路很窄，现在很宽了。
zh: 以前这条路很窄，现在很宽了。
py: yǐ qián zhè tiáo lù hěn zhǎi xiàn zài hěn kuān le
en: This road used to be narrow; now it is wide.
why: "Used to be" in contrast with 现在 is 以前. 后来 would claim it was narrow later, which clashes with 现在 being wide.

q: 睡觉___别喝茶。
zh: 睡觉之前别喝茶。
py: shuì jiào zhī qián bié hē chá
en: Don't drink tea before you go to bed.
why: After a clause, "before" is 之前 (or 以前). 从前 never follows a clause, and 以后 and 后来 would mean after.

q: 出门___，请检查一下门有没有关好。
zh: 出门之前，请检查一下门有没有关好。
py: chū mén zhī qián qǐng jiǎn chá yī xià mén yǒu méi yǒu guān hǎo
en: Before you go out, please check that the door is shut.
why: "Before leaving" is 出门之前. 从前 never follows a clause, 以后 would be after you have left, and 后来 cannot follow a clause.

q: ___，这条街上没有这么多商店。
zh: 从前，这条街上没有这么多商店。
py: cóng qián zhè tiáo jiē shàng méi yǒu zhè me duō shāng diàn
en: Long ago there weren't this many shops on this street.
why: Standing alone, "long ago" is 从前. 之后 and 以后 would point after something, and 后来 is "later on", not "long ago".

q: ___，山上住着一个老爷爷。
zh: 从前，山上住着一个老爷爷。
py: cóng qián shān shàng zhù zhe yī gè lǎo yé ye
en: Once upon a time an old man lived on the mountain.
why: A story opener "once upon a time" is 从前. 然后, 以后 and 后来 all describe something that follows an earlier event, which a story opener lacks.

q: 搬到这个小区___，我每天坐公交车上班。
zh: 搬到这个小区之前，我每天坐公交车上班。
py: bān dào zhè ge xiǎo qū zhī qián wǒ měi tiān zuò gōng jiāo chē shàng bān
en: Before we moved to this neighbourhood, I took the bus to work every day.
why: Attached to a clause, "before" is 之前. 从前 never follows a clause, and 以后 would describe life after the move.

q: 对不起，我今天没有___。
zh: 对不起，我今天没有时间。
py: duì bù qǐ wǒ jīn tiān méi yǒu shí jiān
en: Sorry, I don't have time today.
why: "Have / not have time" is 有时间 / 没有时间. 时候 is a moment, and 小时 and 分钟 are units you would need a number for.

q: 我小___，爸爸常常带我去公园。
zh: 我小时候，爸爸常常带我去公园。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou bà ba cháng cháng dài wǒ qù gōng yuán
en: When I was little, Dad often took me to the park.
why: The fixed phrase 小时候 means "as a child". 小时间 does not exist, and 时代 and 时刻 are different words.

q: ___不早了，我们回家吧。
zh: 时间不早了，我们回家吧。
py: shí jiān bù zǎo le wǒ men huí jiā ba
en: It's getting late, let's go home.
why: "It's getting late" is the clock time passing: 时间不早了. 时候 names a moment and cannot be the subject of 不早了 here.

q: 做这个蛋糕要花很多___。
zh: 做这个蛋糕要花很多时间。
py: zuò zhè ge dàn gāo yào huā hěn duō shí jiān
en: Making this cake takes a lot of time.
why: Time you spend is 花时间. 时候 is a moment when something happens and cannot be spent.

q: 我有___坐地铁上班，有___骑自行车。
zh: 我有时候坐地铁上班，有时候骑自行车。
py: wǒ yǒu shí hou zuò dì tiě shàng bān yǒu shí hou qí zì xíng chē
en: Sometimes I take the subway to work and sometimes I ride a bike.
why: "Sometimes" is 有时候 … 有时候. 有时间 means "have time", which does not say how you get to work.

q: 我现在没有___看电视，作业还没写完。
zh: 我现在没有时间看电视，作业还没写完。
py: wǒ xiàn zài méi yǒu shí jiān kàn diàn shì zuò yè hái méi xiě wán
en: I have no time to watch TV now; my homework isn't finished.
why: Not having time is 没有时间. 时候 is a moment when, and 小时 would need a number in front of it.

q: 孩子们回来的___，饭已经做好了。
zh: 孩子们回来的时候，饭已经做好了。
py: hái zi men huí lái de shí hou fàn yǐ jīng zuò hǎo le
en: By the time the kids came back, dinner was already made.
why: "When" is clause + 的时候. 时间 would mean the length or clock time of the return, and 的以后 and 的后来 are not words.

q: 我想找一个有___的下午，跟爸妈一起去公园走走。
zh: 我想找一个有时间的下午，跟爸妈一起去公园走走。
py: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī gè yǒu shí jiān de xià wǔ gēn bà mā yī qǐ qù gōng yuán zǒu zǒu
en: I want to find a free afternoon to take a walk in the park with my parents.
why: "A free afternoon" is an afternoon where you 有时间. 时候 is a moment, and 有时候 would mean "sometimes".

q: 你___去城里的图书馆？
zh: 你什么时候去城里的图书馆？
py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù chéng lǐ de tú shū guǎn
en: When are you going to the library in town?
why: A point in time is asked with 什么时候 before the verb. 多长时间 asks for a duration and goes after the verb.

q: 你在这个城市住了___？
zh: 你在这个城市住了多长时间？
py: nǐ zài zhè ge chéng shì zhù le duō cháng shí jiān
en: How long have you lived in this city?
why: A length of time is 多长时间, after the verb 住了. 什么时候 asks for a point in time and is placed before the verb.

q: 奶奶做饭要做___？
zh: 奶奶做饭要做多长时间？
py: nǎi nai zuò fàn yào zuò duō cháng shí jiān
en: How long does Grandma take to cook?
why: A duration after the verb is 多长时间. 什么时候 would ask when she cooks, not for how long.

q: 你___能到家？
zh: 你什么时候能到家？
py: nǐ shén me shí hou néng dào jiā
en: When will you get home?
why: The English asks for a point in time, so 什么时候 stands before the verb. 多长时间 asks for a duration and would sit after the verb.

q: 从你家到地铁站，走路要___？
zh: 从你家到地铁站，走路要多长时间？
py: cóng nǐ jiā dào dì tiě zhàn zǒu lù yào duō cháng shí jiān
en: How long does it take to walk from your home to the subway station?
why: "How long" is a duration: 多长时间 after 要. 什么时候 and 几点 ask for a clock time, and 多少钱 asks for a price.

q: 你学做饭学了___了？
zh: 你学做饭学了多长时间了？
py: nǐ xué zuò fàn xué le duō cháng shí jiān le
en: How long have you been learning to cook?
why: Duration of a continuing action is verb + 了 + 多长时间 + 了. 什么时候 asks for a start moment and would not fit after 学了.

q: 你们是___搬到这个小区的？
zh: 你们是什么时候搬到这个小区的？
py: nǐ men shì shén me shí hou bān dào zhè ge xiǎo qū de
en: When did you move to this neighbourhood?
why: 是…的 picks out the time of a completed event, so a point in time: 什么时候 before the verb. 多长时间 would ask for a duration.

q: 从机场到你家开车要___？
zh: 从机场到你家开车要多长时间？
py: cóng jī chǎng dào nǐ jiā kāi chē yào duō cháng shí jiān
en: How long does it take to drive from the airport to your home?
why: Journey length is a duration: 多长时间. 什么时候 and 几点 ask for a clock time, which a trip cannot "take".

q: 你___洗手，然后吃饭。
zh: 你先洗手，然后吃饭。
py: nǐ xiān xǐ shǒu rán hòu chī fàn
en: Wash your hands first, then eat.
why: 先 goes after the subject before the first verb for "first". 再 would be "again / then" and 后 is not used as a standalone adverb.

q: 我们___坐地铁，然后换公共汽车。
zh: 我们先坐地铁，然后换公共汽车。
py: wǒ men xiān zuò dì tiě rán hòu huàn gōng gòng qì chē
en: First we take the subway, then change to a bus.
why: "First … then" pairs 先 with 然后. 才 means "only then", 还 means "still" and 都 means "all".

q: 我今天先做作业，___看电视。
zh: 我今天先做作业，然后看电视。
py: wǒ jīn tiān xiān zuò zuò yè rán hòu kàn diàn shì
en: Today I do my homework first and then watch TV.
why: 先 is answered by 然后 for the next step. 后来 is past only, and 以后 and 以前 cannot link two actions.

q: 我想先回家，___再去找你。
zh: 我想先回家，然后再去找你。
py: wǒ xiǎng xiān huí jiā rán hòu zài qù zhǎo nǐ
en: I'd like to go home first, and then I'll come and find you.
why: 先 … 然后再 … is the planning pattern. 后来 is past only, and 以前 and 从前 look back instead of forward.

q: 回家以后，我先做饭，___洗衣服。
zh: 回家以后，我先做饭，然后洗衣服。
py: huí jiā yǐ hòu wǒ xiān zuò fàn rán hòu xǐ yī fú
en: After I get home I cook first, and then I wash clothes.
why: The second step after 先 is 然后. 以前 and 之前 would put the washing earlier and 后来 is past only.

q: 到了十字路口，你先向右拐，___再往前走一百米，就到了。
zh: 到了十字路口，你先向右拐，然后再往前走一百米，就到了。
py: dào le shí zì lù kǒu nǐ xiān xiàng yòu guǎi rán hòu zài wǎng qián zǒu yī bǎi mǐ jiù dào le
en: At the crossroads turn right first, then walk another hundred metres and you are there.
why: Directions use 先 … 然后再 …. 后来 is past only, and 之前 and 从前 would look back.

q: 孩子们___写作业，然后才能看电视。
zh: 孩子们先写作业，然后才能看电视。
py: hái zi men xiān xiě zuò yè rán hòu cái néng kàn diàn shì
en: The kids do their homework first, and only then can they watch TV.
why: 先 before the verb marks the first step, answered by 然后. 再 means "again / then", 又 means "again", and 也 means "also".

q: 我___很忙，没有时间回家。
zh: 我最近很忙，没有时间回家。
py: wǒ zuì jìn hěn máng méi yǒu shí jiān huí jiā
en: I've been very busy lately and have no time to go home.
why: "Lately, these days" is 最近. 刚才 means only minutes ago, and 以前 and 从前 would mean a past that is over.

q: 爷爷___身体怎么样？
zh: 爷爷最近身体怎么样？
py: yé ye zuì jìn shēn tǐ zěn me yàng
en: How has Grandpa's health been lately?
why: Asking about "these days" uses 最近. 刚才 is a few minutes ago, and 马上 means "right away", which does not fit a state.

q: 我们___要搬家，所以每天都在收拾东西。
zh: 我们最近要搬家，所以每天都在收拾东西。
py: wǒ men zuì jìn yào bān jiā suǒ yǐ měi tiān dōu zài shōu shi dōng xi
en: We are moving soon, so we pack things every day.
why: 最近 can also point to the coming days: "soon". 刚才 is only a moment ago, and 以前 and 后来 look back to the past.

q: 妹妹___迷上了做蛋糕，每个周末都做。
zh: 妹妹最近迷上了做蛋糕，每个周末都做。
py: mèi mei zuì jìn mí shàng le zuò dàn gāo měi gè zhōu mò dōu zuò
en: My sister has got into baking cakes lately; she does it every weekend.
why: A recent habit of every weekend fits 最近. 刚才 is minutes ago, and 从前 and 然后 do not describe a recent habit.

q: ___，这条街上新开了好几家饭馆，晚上特别热闹。
zh: 最近，这条街上新开了好几家饭馆，晚上特别热闹。
py: zuì jìn zhè tiáo jiē shàng xīn kāi le hǎo jǐ jiā fàn guǎn wǎn shàng tè bié rè nao
en: Recently several new restaurants have opened on this street, and it is lively at night.
why: Several openings over weeks is 最近. 刚才 is only minutes ago, and 从前 and 以后 do not report recent events.

q: 我___给奶奶打了个电话，挂了才一分钟。
zh: 我刚才给奶奶打了个电话，挂了才一分钟。
py: wǒ gāng cái gěi nǎi nai dǎ le gè diàn huà guà le cái yī fēn zhōng
en: I phoned Grandma just now; I only hung up a minute ago.
why: The call ended one minute ago, so 刚才. 最近 means days or weeks, and 以前 and 后来 do not mean "just now".

q: 你等一下，我___来。
zh: 你等一下，我马上来。
py: nǐ děng yī xià wǒ mǎ shàng lái
en: Wait a moment, I'll be right there.
why: "Right away" is 马上, placed after the subject before the verb. 刚才 would say that you came a moment ago.

q: ___谁给你打电话了？
zh: 刚才谁给你打电话了？
py: gāng cái shuí gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà le
en: Who phoned you just now?
why: A call a few minutes ago is 刚才. 最近 would ask about recent weeks, and 马上 is a future adverb that cannot go with a finished call.

q: 电影___就要开始了，快进去吧。
zh: 电影马上就要开始了，快进去吧。
py: diàn yǐng mǎ shàng jiù yào kāi shǐ le kuài jìn qù ba
en: The film is about to start, hurry in.
why: 马上就要…了 means "about to". 刚才 and 以前 look back, so they cannot go with 就要 … 了.

q: 我___在公交车上，一会儿就到家。
zh: 我现在在公交车上，一会儿就到家。
py: wǒ xiàn zài zài gōng jiāo chē shàng yī huì r jiù dào jiā
en: I'm on the bus right now and will be home in a moment.
why: The present state is 现在 before the verb. 以前, 后来 and 从前 all point to the past, which clashes with 一会儿就到家.

q: 爸爸___还在开会，你先别给他打电话。
zh: 爸爸现在还在开会，你先别给他打电话。
py: bà ba xiàn zài hái zài kāi huì nǐ xiān bié gěi tā dǎ diàn huà
en: Dad is still in a meeting right now, so don't call him yet.
why: "Right now" is 现在, before the verb. 后来 and 以前 are past, and 然后 only links steps.

q: 妈妈___还在厨房，现在去哪儿了？
zh: 妈妈刚才还在厨房，现在去哪儿了？
py: mā ma gāng cái hái zài chú fáng xiàn zài qù nǎ r le
en: Mum was still in the kitchen a moment ago; where has she gone now?
why: A moment ago contrasted with 现在 is 刚才. 马上 is future, 最近 is weeks, and 以后 does not mean "a moment ago".

q: 这座城市十年___还没有地铁。
zh: 这座城市十年以前还没有地铁。
py: zhè zuò chéng shì shí nián yǐ qián hái méi yǒu dì tiě
en: Ten years ago this city still had no subway.
why: "Ago" is amount + 以前. 从前 never follows an amount, and 以后 and 后来 would not fit the English "ago".

q: 你明天有___吗？
zh: 你明天有时间吗？
py: nǐ míng tiān yǒu shí jiān ma
en: Do you have time tomorrow?
why: "Have time" is 有时间. 有时候 means "sometimes" and would not take 吗 here, and 小时 and 分钟 are units.

q: 奶奶___身体不太好，我们常去看她。
zh: 奶奶最近身体不太好，我们常去看她。
py: nǎi nai zuì jìn shēn tǐ bù tài hǎo wǒ men cháng qù kàn tā
en: Grandma hasn't been well lately, so we often go to see her.
why: A condition over recent weeks is 最近. 刚才 is minutes ago, 马上 is "right away" and 以前 would mean it is over.

zh: 吃饭以前我先洗手。
py: chī fàn yǐ qián wǒ xiān xǐ shǒu
en: Before I eat, I wash my hands first.
why: The 以前 phrase comes after its clause and before the verb; 先 sits right before 洗手. 以前 cannot come at the start of the clause.

zh: 妈妈下班以后去超市。
py: mā ma xià bān yǐ hòu qù chāo shì
en: After work, Mum goes to the supermarket.
why: 下班以后 is "after X", placed before the verb, either before or after the subject. It cannot stand at the end of the sentence.

zh: 我小的时候住在外婆家。
py: wǒ xiǎo de shí hou zhù zài wài pó jiā
en: When I was little I lived at my grandmother's house.
why: 小的时候 is a time phrase and goes before the verb 住在. It cannot follow 外婆家.

zh: 你什么时候去奶奶家？
py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù nǎi nai jiā
en: When are you going to Grandma's house?
why: 什么时候 asks "when" and stands before the verb, after or before the subject, never at the end.

zh: 我们三年以前搬到这个城市。
py: wǒ men sān nián yǐ qián bān dào zhè ge chéng shì
en: We moved to this city three years ago.
why: "Ago" is amount + 以前, and the whole phrase goes before the verb. English-style 以前三年 is wrong.

zh: 你在这儿住了多长时间？
py: nǐ zài zhè r zhù le duō cháng shí jiān
en: How long have you lived here?
why: A duration comes after the verb: 住了多长时间. Putting 多长时间 before the verb as in 你多长时间住 is wrong.

zh: 爸爸先做饭然后洗衣服。
py: bà ba xiān zuò fàn rán hòu xǐ yī fú
en: Dad cooks first and then washes the clothes.
why: 先 sits between the subject and the first verb, and 然后 opens the second step. 先 cannot come before 爸爸.

zh: 他最近在学做饭。
py: tā zuì jìn zài xué zuò fàn
en: He has been learning to cook lately.
why: 最近 goes before the verb and may come before or after the subject. It cannot go at the end of the sentence.

zh: 孩子们回来的时候我正在做饭。
py: hái zi men huí lái de shí hou wǒ zhèng zài zuò fàn
en: I was cooking when the kids came back.
why: The 的时候 clause is a time frame placed before the main verb; the subject 我 may come before or after it. 的时候 must close its clause.

zh: 你到家以后马上给我打电话。
py: nǐ dào jiā yǐ hòu mǎ shàng gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
en: Call me right away after you get home.
why: The 以后 phrase comes first, then the adverb 马上 just before the verb phrase. Putting 马上 before the 以后 phrase would change the meaning.

src_py: wǒ xiān chī fàn zài zuò zuò yè
task: Use 然后 instead of 再.
zh: 我先吃饭然后做作业。
py: wǒ xiān chī fàn rán hòu zuò zuò yè
en: I eat first and then do my homework.
why: 先 … 然后 … is the standard pair. 然后 replaces 再 and opens the second step; 先 stays after the subject.

src_py: wǒ men sān nián qián bān dào běi jīng
task: Use 以前 instead of 前.
zh: 我们三年以前搬到北京。
py: wǒ men sān nián yǐ qián bān dào běi jīng
en: We moved to Beijing three years ago.
why: The long form is amount + 以前, placed before the verb, with the subject before or after it.

src_py: nǐ míng tiān qù chāo shì
task: Turn it into a question: when?
zh: 你什么时候去超市？
py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù chāo shì
en: When are you going to the supermarket?
why: 什么时候 replaces 明天 in the same place, before the verb.

src_py: wǒ men xué le liǎng nián hàn yǔ
zh: 你们学了多长时间汉语？
py: nǐ men xué le duō cháng shí jiān hàn yǔ
en: How long did you study Chinese?
why: The duration goes right after 学了, before the object, so 多长时间 takes the spot of 两年.

src: 我们吃完饭以后去看电影。
src_py: wǒ men chī wán fàn yǐ hòu qù kàn diàn yǐng
task: Say it with 先 … 然后 ….
zh: 我们先吃饭然后去看电影。
py: wǒ men xiān chī fàn rán hòu qù kàn diàn yǐng
en: We eat first and then go to see a film.
why: 先 follows the subject before the first verb, and 然后 opens the second step. Do not keep 以后 as well.

s: 我们是以前三年搬到这儿的。
s_py: wǒ men shì yǐ qián sān nián bān dào zhè r de
zh: 我们是三年以前搬到这儿的。
py: wǒ men shì sān nián yǐ qián bān dào zhè r de
en: We moved here three years ago.
why: "Ago" is amount + 以前. Putting 以前 before 三年 follows English "before three years" and is wrong in Chinese.

s: 时候我做饭，爸爸看电视。
s_py: shí hou wǒ zuò fàn bà ba kàn diàn shì
zh: 我做饭的时候，爸爸看电视。
py: wǒ zuò fàn de shí hou bà ba kàn diàn shì
en: While I cook, Dad watches TV.
why: "When" cannot open the clause; the clause comes first and 的时候 follows it. 时候 at the start is not Chinese.

s: 下课后来我们回家。
s_py: xià kè hòu lái wǒ men huí jiā
zh: 下课以后我们回家。
py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men huí jiā
en: After class we go home.
why: 后来 cannot be attached to a clause. "After X" is X + 以后, in the future as well as the past.

s: 明天我们先去银行，后来去超市。
s_py: míng tiān wǒ men xiān qù yín háng hòu lái qù chāo shì
zh: 明天我们先去银行，然后去超市。
py: míng tiān wǒ men xiān qù yín háng rán hòu qù chāo shì
en: Tomorrow we go to the bank first and then the supermarket.
why: 后来 refers to the past only. A planned next step after 先 is 然后.

s: 先我洗手，然后吃饭。
s_py: xiān wǒ xǐ shǒu rán hòu chī fàn
zh: 我先洗手，然后吃饭。
py: wǒ xiān xǐ shǒu rán hòu chī fàn
en: I wash my hands first and then eat.
why: 先 is an adverb and must come after the subject. English "First, I …" does not carry over to 先我.

s: 三年从前我们住在上海。
s_py: sān nián cóng qián wǒ men zhù zài shàng hǎi
zh: 三年以前我们住在上海。
py: sān nián yǐ qián wǒ men zhù zài shàng hǎi
en: Three years ago we lived in Shanghai.
why: 从前 only stands alone as "once, long ago". After a time amount the word is 以前 or 之前.

s: 对不起，我现在没有时候。
s_py: duì bù qǐ wǒ xiàn zài méi yǒu shí hou
zh: 对不起，我现在没有时间。
py: duì bù qǐ wǒ xiàn zài méi yǒu shí jiān
en: Sorry, I have no time right now.
why: Time you can have or lack is 时间. 时候 is only the moment at which something happens.

s: 你在这儿住了什么时候？
s_py: nǐ zài zhè r zhù le shén me shí hou
zh: 你在这儿住了多长时间？
py: nǐ zài zhè r zhù le duō cháng shí jiān
en: How long have you lived here?
why: The question asks for a length of time, so it needs 多长时间 after the verb. 什么时候 asks for a point in time.

s: 你等一下，我来马上。
s_py: nǐ děng yī xià wǒ lái mǎ shàng
zh: 你等一下，我马上来。
py: nǐ děng yī xià wǒ mǎ shàng lái
en: Wait a moment, I'll come right away.
why: 马上 is an adverb and must come before the verb. It cannot end the sentence as in English "come right away".

s: 我很忙最近。
s_py: wǒ hěn máng zuì jìn
zh: 我最近很忙。
py: wǒ zuì jìn hěn máng
en: I've been busy lately.
why: 最近 goes before the verb or adjective. Placing it at the end like English "lately" is not possible.

s: 他走了刚才。
s_py: tā zǒu le gāng cái
zh: 他刚才走了。
py: tā gāng cái zǒu le
en: He left just now.
why: 刚才 is a time word and goes before the verb. It cannot follow 走了.

s: 去年搬家以后，我们每天都坐地铁上班。
s_py: qù nián bān jiā yǐ hòu wǒ men měi tiān dōu zuò dì tiě shàng bān
zh: 去年搬家以后，我们每天都坐地铁上班。
py: qù nián bān jiā yǐ hòu wǒ men měi tiān dōu zuò dì tiě shàng bān
en: Since we moved house last year, we have taken the subway to work every day.
why: X + 以后 works for a past event as well as a future one. 后来 could not follow 搬家 here, so 以后 is exactly right.

s: 我们以前是邻居，后来他搬到了别的城市。
s_py: wǒ men yǐ qián shì lín jū hòu lái tā bān dào le bié de chéng shì
zh: 我们以前是邻居，后来他搬到了别的城市。
py: wǒ men yǐ qián shì lín jū hòu lái tā bān dào le bié de chéng shì
en: We used to be neighbours; later he moved to another city.
why: 后来 stands alone at the start of its clause in a past story, and 以前 alone means "formerly". Both are used correctly.

s: 以后我一定常常回家看你们。
s_py: yǐ hòu wǒ yī dìng cháng cháng huí jiā kàn nǐ men
zh: 以后我一定常常回家看你们。
py: yǐ hòu wǒ yī dìng cháng cháng huí jiā kàn nǐ men
en: From now on I will definitely come home to see you often.
why: 以后 standing alone means "from now on" and is the correct word for the future. 后来 would be wrong here.

s: 我小时候家里没有电视。
s_py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou jiā lǐ méi yǒu diàn shì
zh: 我小时候家里没有电视。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou jiā lǐ méi yǒu diàn shì
en: We had no TV at home when I was little.
why: 小时候 is a fixed word and does not take 的. 小的时候 would also work, but 小时候 is the usual form.

s: 我们先吃饭，再去散步。
s_py: wǒ men xiān chī fàn zài qù sàn bù
zh: 我们先吃饭，再去散步。
py: wǒ men xiān chī fàn zài qù sàn bù
en: We eat first and then go for a walk.
why: 先 … 再 … is correct without 然后; 再 marks the second step in a plan. 然后 would also work but is not required.

s: 我现在在地铁上，马上就到。
s_py: wǒ xiàn zài zài dì tiě shàng mǎ shàng jiù dào
zh: 我现在在地铁上，马上就到。
py: wǒ xiàn zài zài dì tiě shàng mǎ shàng jiù dào
en: I'm on the subway now and will be there right away.
why: 现在 sits before the verb phrase after the subject, and 马上就 comes right before the verb 到. Both are in the correct place.

s: 你学汉语学了多长时间了？
s_py: nǐ xué hàn yǔ xué le duō cháng shí jiān le
zh: 你学汉语学了多长时间了？
py: nǐ xué hàn yǔ xué le duō cháng shí jiān le
en: How long have you been learning Chinese?
why: With an object, the verb is repeated and 多长时间 comes after 学了. The final 了 shows the study is still going on. This is correct.

s: 从前，这儿没有路，也没有车。
s_py: cóng qián zhè r méi yǒu lù yě méi yǒu chē
zh: 从前，这儿没有路，也没有车。
py: cóng qián zhè r méi yǒu lù yě méi yǒu chē
en: Long ago there were no roads or cars here.
why: 从前 stands alone at the start of the sentence as "long ago". It is correct here because nothing precedes it.

s: 最近你身体怎么样？
s_py: zuì jìn nǐ shēn tǐ zěn me yàng
zh: 最近你身体怎么样？
py: zuì jìn nǐ shēn tǐ zěn me yàng
en: How has your health been lately?
why: 最近 can come before the subject. It is a time word and only has to stay before the verb or predicate.
